en: Colored historic street scene showing a broad intersection lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings. On the right is a long, light-yellow building with a red-tiled roof and a church tower with a cross rising behind it. Horse-drawn carts and carriages stand on the street, and pedestrians walk along the sidewalks. The image is framed by handwritten script along the right margin and printed text in Hungarian at the top and along the left side, indicating it is a greeting from Pécs and naming the street as Ferenciek utca.
